method: 5-fold split of genes; PCA-30 of each model, CCA(10, max_iter=200) and Procrustes fitted on training genes only; canonical r = correlation of held-out canonical scores (mean of 10, averaged over folds); top-1 = held-out gene's nearest neighbour among ALL n genes of the other model; values are means over repeats, range = min-max over repeats
